definitions.explanation: A train service that stops at every station on the line. Short for {各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ}.

examples.japanese: この{駅|えき}には{各停|かくてい}しか{止|と}まらない。
examples.english: Only local trains stop at this station.

examples.japanese: {各停|かくてい}だと{時間|じかん}がかかるが、{座|すわ}れる。
examples.english: The local takes longer, but you can get a seat.

notes:
{各停|かくてい} is an abbreviation of {各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ} (stopping at each station).

TRAIN SERVICE HIERARCHY:
- {各停|かくてい}/{普通|ふつう}: local (slowest, all stops)
- {快速|かいそく}: rapid
- {急行|きゅうこう}: express
- {特急|とっきゅう}: limited express (fastest)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {各停|かくてい}に{乗|の}る: to take a local train
- {各停|かくてい}しか{止|と}まらない: only locals stop
- {各停|かくてい}で{行|い}く: to go by local train

USAGE:
- Also called {普通|ふつう} on some lines
- Sometimes advantageous for getting a seat on crowded lines
